description: Super-saw oscillator: one centre oscillator, a chosen number of hard-panned detuned oscillator pairs, a band-limited noise oscillator, and an amplitude envelope

params.text: Sets the tuning of every oscillator
Drops the centre oscillator one octave, and drops the band limit of that oscillator one octave with it
Sets how far low-passed white noise moves the pitch of each oscillator
Sets the speed of the low-passed white noise that moves the pitch of each oscillator
Sets how far the side oscillators are detuned from the centre oscillator
Sets the level of the side oscillators against the centre oscillator
Sets the level of the band-limited noise oscillator
Sets the sustain level held by the noise oscillator, which is separate from the sustain of the amplitude envelope
Sets how many hard-panned oscillator pairs sound alongside the centre oscillator
Sets the brightness of the noise oscillator
Sets the highest frequency the oscillators produce, from 14kHz to 20kHz
Sets the attack time of the amplitude envelope
Sets the decay time of the amplitude envelope
Sets the level the amplitude envelope holds while the gate is high
Sets the release time of the amplitude envelope
Inverts the polarity of the hard-panned side oscillators

inputs.text: A high gate opens the amplitude envelope, and the release begins when the gate falls
Sets the pitch at one volt per octave, added to the tuning set by NOTE
Modulates the level of the side oscillators set by MIX
Modulates the detuning of the side oscillators set by DETUNE
Modulates the tuning set by the NOTE knob

outputs.text: The left channel of the stereo output
The right channel of the stereo output
